dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you reproduce this error in your browser?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. It happens after I submit the form with an empty email field.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you attach a screenshot and list the steps?
dialogue.zh: 你能附上一张截图，并列出操作步骤吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll include the expected and actual results too.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我也会写上预期结果和实际结果。

dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 确认环境与操作步骤，请求可复查的错误证据。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers debugging at a desk. A central desktop monitor clearly displays ONE browser window with a recognizable top tab and address bar, a simple form, and a small warning triangle. Beside the monitor, on the lower-right part of the desk, place one fully visible printed screenshot sheet, showing a miniature copy of the same browser window and warning triangle. One coworker points toward the monitor and the other toward the printed sheet. Make browser window and screenshot sheet separately recognizable and unobstructed. No readable text, no code, no extra sheets.

coverage_review.scope: W051 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W051.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：屏幕浏览器具有地址栏、标签页、表单和警告符号；桌上纸质截图展示同一界面副本。两名人物分别指屏幕和截图；实际手指局部遮住窗口/纸张，不影响整体指代。browser/screenshot可定位，reproduce/error由对白支持。
